# Bid the type, the waste, and the extra work.

> Price an artificial turf install from landscape, pet, or putting-green turf: lawn square footage, 15-foot-roll waste, crushed-rock base, sod demo, infill, seams, and tree wells — not a published $8-a-square-foot special. See the turf you have to buy and the walk-away number.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
